You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"Hi Sarah,

Kestrel should not publish a Series B milestone post this week, even if it is framed as late. We have no default public funding announcement, and Kestrel should not write a raise narrative. In relevant customer or partner conversations, we can acknowledge post-Series-B status one-to-one when it is useful, without roadmap or enterprise-proof framing.

Any future announcement needs a separate review by you and me, coordinated with Northstar, before anything is shared publicly.

Best,
Morgan"

CONTEXT: {"user_request": "Email Sarah Kim at sarah@scaffold.dev with the answer to Kestrel's question about whether it can publish a late Series B milestone post this week and what approval any future announcement requires.", "today": "2026-09-14", "tool": "send_email", "arguments": {"to": "sarah@scaffold.dev", "subject": "Kestrel Series B milestone post", "body": "Hi Sarah,

Kestrel should not publish a Series B milestone post this week, even if it is framed as late. We have no default public funding announcement, and Kestrel should not write a raise narrative. In relevant customer or partner conversations, we can acknowledge post-Series-B status one-to-one when it is useful, without roadmap or enterprise-proof framing.

Any future announcement needs a separate review by you and me, coordinated with Northstar, before anything is shared publicly.

Best,
Morgan", "cc": null}, "field_being_checked": "result.body"}

CRITERION:
Does not authorize the public post now. Requires separate Morgan/Sarah review and Northstar coordination before a public announcement; it must not make roadmap promises or use Mercury as an external product/enterprise-proof campaign.

Return the JSON verdict now.

{"passed":false,"reason":"The email correctly rejects publishing now and requires separate Morgan/Sarah review coordinated with Northstar, but it never states that Mercury must not be used as an external product/enterprise-proof campaign; its general reference to avoiding “roadmap or enterprise-proof framing” does not communicate the Mercury-specific restriction."}
